title: Synthesis, characterisation, DNA binding, acetylcholinesterase (AChE) and butyrylcholinesterase (BuChE) activities and molecular docking studies of metal(II) complexes with 1,10-phenanthroline scaffold.
authors: Gladis, E H Edinsha; Nagashri, K; Anisha, M; Joseph, J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金属配合物与DNA的结合及胆碱酯酶抑制活性，虽含DNA结合和分子对接，但核心是药物化学而非TF-DNA互作机制，方法为常规对接，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: A series of metal complexes containing Phenanthroline scaffold [ML] (L-1,10-Phenanthroline derivative comprises conjugated aromatic core and selenol group); M = Cu(II), Zn(II), Co(II) and Zn(II) ions were designed and synthesised to obtain effective anti-cholinesterase efficiencies of metal chelates. Analytical and spectroscopic studies were used to determine the structural features. An octahedral structure with moderate distortion was attributed to the above metal chelates based on spectroscopic data. The distorted octahedral geometry of copper(II) complex to DNA (K(b) = 4.05 x 10(5) M(-1)) is stronger than that of ethidium bromide (EB) to DNA (K(b) = 3.2 x 10(5) M(-1)), other metal complexes, respectively. The synthesised 1,10-Phenanthroline derivative had the best inhibitory effects against acetylcholinesterase (AChE) and butyrylcholinesterase, with IC(50) values of 0.45 and 3.6 M, respectively, which were lower than the reference molecules. As a result, nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compounds (H(2)L) showed significant inhibitory profiles against the metabolic enzymes. Therefore, we believe that these experimental results may contribute to the development of new drug molecules particularly in the treatment of neurological disorders including glaucoma, Alzheimer's disease (AD) and diabetes. Docking, AChE and BuChE inhibition activities results revealed that ligand may be used for AD. The prepared 1,10-phenanthroline analogue, which has a high selectivity for AChE, may be studied further to find potential candidates for treating early-stage Alzheimer's symptoms.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 设计并合成了一系列含有菲咯啉骨架的金属配合物[ML]（L-1,10-菲咯啉衍生物包含共轭芳香核心和硒醇基团）；M = Cu(II)、Zn(II)、Co(II)和Zn(II)离子，以获得金属螯合物的有效抗胆碱酯酶效率。采用分析和光谱研究来确定结构特征。基于光谱数据，上述金属螯合物被归为具有中等畸变的八面体结构。铜(II)配合物与DNA的结合强度（K(b) = 4.05 x 10(5) M(-1)）强于溴化乙锭（EB）与DNA的结合强度（K(b) = 3.2 x 10(5) M(-1)），也强于其他金属配合物。合成的1,10-菲咯啉衍生物对乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）和丁酰胆碱酯酶具有最佳抑制效果，IC(50)值分别为0.45和3.6 M，低于参考分子。因此，含氮杂环化合物（H(2)L）对代谢酶表现出显著的抑制特性。因此，我们相信这些实验结果可能有助于新药分子的开发，特别是在治疗包括青光眼、阿尔茨海默病（AD）和糖尿病在内的神经系统疾病方面。对接、AChE和BuChE抑制活性结果表明，该配体可能用于AD治疗。所制备的1,10-菲咯啉类似物对AChE具有高选择性，可进一步研究以寻找治疗早期阿尔茨海默症状的潜在候选药物。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
